g.text: 8B target / 1B draft: speed is conditional on output equivalence
3 public prompts × 3 repeats per arm; 128-token budget. Each panel has its own timing baseline.
Blue circles: identical token sequence. Red crosses: unequal output, disqualified as exact-output speedup. Black tick: median.
Single-session pilot; no confidence interval, phone result or energy claim.
